text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both holding steady with nearly identical 24-hour declines of 0.7%, suggesting coordinated consolidation rather than directional conviction. The Fear & Greed index sits at 55 (Greed) but has fallen 9 points over the week, indicating sentiment is cooling from recent highs even as the market hasn't turned fearful. Bitcoin dominance at 59.3% and exceptionally high volume of $165.6 trillion point to healthy participation across the market, though the lack of meaningful price movement suggests traders are cautious and waiting for a clearer signal.
